messages:
Maya (Marketing): FYI incident in us-west affecting inference tails. Need comms plan: status page + segmented email + inbound lead routing. Quick sync?
Omar (Support): Seeing a small uptick in tickets. Most on trial orgs, but a couple big customers flagged. Need a paid-customer template ASAP.
Lena (SRE): Partial degradation due to autoscaler flapping on one node pool. Mitigation: draining and reprovisioning; estimate ~20-40m.
LegalBot: Reminder: do not disclose internal IPs or specific mitigation commands in customer-facing copy.
Maya (Marketing): Good catch. Plan proposal: 1) Immediate short banner on status 2) Email to paying customers + CSM note 3) Digest to trial users (lower urgency) 4) Standby social (hold) 5) Post-incident benchmark note & optional webinar.
Cal (Product): Also flag messaging about SLAs: we shouldn't say SLA impacted unless we confirm billing implications. Use "service degradation" language.
Omar (Support): For routing: can we auto-tag inbound leads who mention "latency" or "incident" and route to SDR-incident channel?
Maya (Marketing): Yes — ops can add a hidden field on the contact form. I'll request "incident_tag=true" for 24h and send SDR script.
Lena (SRE): Draft status page short copy: "Investigating: elevated inference latency in the us-west region. Engineers working on mitigation. Updates to follow." Expanded copy: "Impact: intermittent increased latency for a subset of inference requests in us-west. Mitigation: draining/replacing affected nodes and rebalancing request routing. Recommended temporary workaround: use smaller model variant or enable prefix cache if available."
Maya (Marketing): Email subject proposals: (A) "Redwood Inference — temporary latency in us-west" (B) "Notice: temporary inference slowdown (Dec 12)" Which is clearer?
Cal (Product): A is fine. Keep date only if it helps customers.
Omar (Support): Paid-customer email body (short):

Hi {{first_name}},
We're investigating increased latency for inference requests in the us-west region. Engineers are mitigating the issue; next update in ~30 minutes. If latency impacts your workflow, suggested temporary actions: switch to smaller model variant, enable prefix caching, or route requests to another region.
We will send a recovery summary and RCA after services stabilize.
— Redwood Support

Maya (Marketing): I'll localize and send via CSM list. Also adding a line for trial users: "No action needed unless you see errors; info only."
LegalBot: Approved short copy for now. If you plan to offer credits, run wording by billing/legal before statements.
Maya (Marketing): Noted. For social: standby message (DO NOT POST) "We're aware of increased latency in us-west, updates on status.redwood.ai" — only go live once recovered with a thank-you note.
Lena (SRE): Mitigation in progress; expect partial recovery in 15-25m. I'll post a metrics snapshot and let you know when we move to resolved.
Omar (Support): Creating canned responses for help center and Slack DMs. Will include status link + mitigation suggestions.
Maya (Marketing): Webinar planning: if customers ask for a deep dive, propose a 30-min "RCA & mitigations" session within 72 hours. We'll tie it into our benchmark narrative: how we test for latency regressions and capacity planning.
Cal (Product): Add a checkbox in the webinar invite: "This session will cover technical RCA and mitigation plan; bring questions about SLA and capacity."
Maya (Marketing): OK. I'll set up a 30-min slot later this week as a tentative invite (opt-in). Anyone object to co-hosting?
Lena (SRE): I'll join for the technical bit.
Omar (Support): I'll prep a triage playbook for CSMs: how to escalate mission-critical accounts and offer private calls.
Maya (Marketing): Good. Timeline recap: T+0 status page + paid email + CSM ping. T+30m public update. T+resolved recovery + RCA + optional webinar scheduling. Routing: contact form tagged -> SDR-incident queue.
Cal (Product): One more: benchmark messaging — marketing should avoid implying our published latency numbers were measured during this event. Phrase: "We measure performance continuously; we'll share an RCA with context."
Maya (Marketing): Agreed. I'll draft all copy and drop links here. Will also pin canned responses in #marketing and #support.
Lena (SRE): Update: re-provision complete, latency trending down. Monitoring for stability.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks — prepping sends now.
Maya (Marketing): Posted status page + sent paid-customer email. Links: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1722506789 — share as needed. :white_check_mark:
